symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_SLOT16
symbols.comment: Detected slot number multiplied by 16; used as the slot I/O index.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_TEMP
symbols.comment: BOOT0 scratch byte reused for GCR candidates, 4-and-4 address decode and data-buffer indexing.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_SECTOR
symbols.comment: Requested sector number; starts at zero and advances as boot pages are loaded.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_ADDR_TRACK
symbols.comment: Track value decoded from the disk address field.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_TRACK
symbols.comment: Requested track number; initialized to zero for booting.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_DEST_LO
symbols.comment: Low byte of the BOOT0 destination pointer; reused Monitor zero-page storage.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_DEST_HI
symbols.comment: High byte of the BOOT0 destination pointer; initially $08.

symbols.name: COMMENT_CPU_STACK
symbols.comment: 6502 stack page; inspect the pushed return address to identify the slot.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_GCR_TABLE
symbols.comment: Base used when constructing the sparse inverse 6-and-2 GCR conversion table.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_GCR_INDEX
symbols.comment: GCR decode-table base biased by -$80, so raw nibble values in Y select the correct translation byte.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_AUX_BITS
symbols.comment: 86-byte temporary buffer carrying the low two bits of the 256 reconstructed sector bytes.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_BOOT_COUNT
symbols.comment: Sector count in the first loaded boot block; this byte is not a BASIC program header.

symbols.name: COMMENT_D2_BOOT1
symbols.comment: Entry point of the loaded next-stage disk bootstrap.

symbols.name: COMMENT_MON_WAIT
symbols.comment: Monitor busy-wait routine; A controls the delay.

symbols.name: COMMENT_MON_IORTS
symbols.comment: Monitor RTS instruction called to leave a return address on the stack for slot detection.

symbols.name: COMMENT_LSLOT
symbols.comment: Last booted slot number * 16

symbols.name: COMMENT_SLOTIO
symbols.comment: Slot I/O

symbols.name: COMMENT_M.WAIT

symbols.comment: VARIABLE 1

symbols.name: COMMENT_C600_7
symbols.comment: Controller signature / boot entry; initial X=$20 is overwritten by X=$03 before GCR-table construction.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C606_8
symbols.comment: Preserve the candidate disk-nibble pattern for the GCR validity test.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C609_9
symbols.comment: Shift the candidate left to test adjacent bit positions.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C60A_10
symbols.comment: Set flags from candidate AND shifted candidate; BIT does not modify A.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C60C_11
symbols.comment: Skip a candidate when the BIT test sets Z.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C60E_12
symbols.comment: Combine the original candidate with the shifted candidate.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C610_13
symbols.comment: Invert the candidate-test pattern to expose zero-bit runs.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C612_14
symbols.comment: Ignore the endpoint bits while testing the interior bit pattern.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C61A_15
symbols.comment: Map this accepted encoded nibble to the next six-bit value in the sparse page-3 GCR table.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C621_16
symbols.comment: Call a Monitor RTS so its return-address bytes remain in stack RAM for slot detection.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C624_17
symbols.comment: Copy the stack pointer into X; this does not copy the processor status register.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C625_18
symbols.comment: Read the saved return-address high byte from stack RAM to identify the controller slot.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C62B_19
symbols.comment: Fourth shift derives slot*16 for indexed accesses to the $C08x controller bases.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C62F_20
symbols.comment: Set Q7 low to select controller input/read mode; effective address is $C0EE when X=$60.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C632_21
symbols.comment: Set Q6 low so Q7=0,Q6=0 selects disk-data reading; effective address is $C0EC when X=$60.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C635_22
symbols.comment: Select drive 1 through the slot-relative drive-select strobe.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C638_23
symbols.comment: Turn the selected drive motor on before head recalibration and sector reading.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C63B_24
symbols.comment: Initialize the outward head-recalibration phase-step countdown.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C63D_25
symbols.comment: Release the currently indexed stepper phase; X contains slot and phase offset.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C641_26
symbols.comment: Reduce the countdown to phase number 0..3.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C643_27
symbols.comment: Convert the phase number to the corresponding two-byte soft-switch offset.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C647_28
symbols.comment: Energize the newly selected phase; X now includes the selected phase offset.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C64A_29
symbols.comment: Set A for a short mechanical-settling delay between stepper phase changes.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C64C_30
symbols.comment: Call the Monitor delay with A=$56 (about 19,664 CPU cycles per step, not 1.9664 seconds).

symbols.name: COMMENT_C650_31
symbols.comment: Repeat outward phase stepping while the countdown remains nonnegative.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C652_32
symbols.comment: Initialize the destination-pointer low byte for sector data at $0800.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C654_33
symbols.comment: Initialize the requested sector to zero.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C656_34
symbols.comment: Initialize the requested track to zero.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C65A_35
symbols.comment: Initialize the destination-pointer high byte to $08.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C65D_36
symbols.comment: Preserve carry, which records whether the search expects an address field or a data field.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C65E_37
symbols.comment: Poll disk data until a complete nibble is available in bit 7.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C661_38
symbols.comment: BPL retries while bit 7 is clear; the nibble is not ready yet.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C665_39
symbols.comment: Retry until the candidate equals the prologue byte $D5.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C667_40
symbols.comment: Poll for the next complete prologue nibble.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C66A_41
symbols.comment: BPL retries while bit 7 is clear.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C66E_42
symbols.comment: Reject a second prologue byte other than $AA; recheck the candidate sequence.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C671_43
symbols.comment: Poll for the third prologue byte identifying an address or data field.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C674_44
symbols.comment: BPL retries while bit 7 is clear.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C678_45
symbols.comment: Recognize $D5,$AA,$96 as an address-field prologue.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C67A_46
symbols.comment: Restore the carry flag that identifies the current prologue-search phase.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C67B_47
symbols.comment: If no matching address was found, restart the address-field search.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C67F_48
symbols.comment: Recognize the $AD data-field marker after the requested address was found.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C681_49
symbols.comment: Restart the sector search when the data-field marker is not $AD.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C685_50
symbols.comment: Save the previously decoded address-field byte; after three passes $40 holds the track.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C687_51
symbols.comment: Poll for the first nibble of a 4-and-4 encoded address byte.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C68A_52
symbols.comment: Wait until this first address nibble has bit 7 set.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C68F_53
symbols.comment: Poll for the second nibble of the 4-and-4 address byte.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C692_54
symbols.comment: Wait until the second address nibble has bit 7 set.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C694_55
symbols.comment: Combine the second nibble with the rotated first nibble to reconstruct an address byte.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C697_56
symbols.comment: Decode all three useful address bytes: volume, track and sector.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C699_57
symbols.comment: Restore the saved search-phase carry flag after decoding the address field.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C69A_58
symbols.comment: Compare the decoded sector in A with the requested sector.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C69C_59
symbols.comment: Resume scanning if this is not the requested sector.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C69E_60
symbols.comment: Load the decoded track from the preceding address-field byte.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6A0_61
symbols.comment: Compare the decoded track with the requested track.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6A2_62
symbols.comment: Resume scanning if this is not the requested track.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6A4_63
symbols.comment: With a matching address, preserve carry set and search for its following data prologue.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6A6_64
symbols.comment: Prepare to read the 86 auxiliary six-bit values into the low-bit buffer.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6A8_65
symbols.comment: Save the auxiliary-buffer index while Y is used for a raw disk nibble.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6AA_66
symbols.comment: Read an auxiliary disk nibble into Y for GCR translation.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6AF_67
symbols.comment: Translate the raw nibble and accumulate XOR decoding of the auxiliary data stream.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6B2_68
symbols.comment: Recover the saved auxiliary-buffer index.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6B5_69
symbols.comment: Store decoded auxiliary bits in the page-3 temporary buffer.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6BA_70
symbols.comment: Save the main-sector destination index while Y is used for a raw disk nibble.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6BC_71
symbols.comment: Read the next main data nibble into Y for GCR translation.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6C1_72
symbols.comment: Translate the main data nibble and apply the cumulative XOR decode.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6C4_73
symbols.comment: Recover the saved sector-buffer index.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6C6_74
symbols.comment: Store the decoded six-bit value through the BOOT0 destination pointer.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6CB_75
symbols.comment: Read the final checksum nibble into Y.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6D0_76
symbols.comment: Translate and XOR the checksum nibble; a valid data stream leaves A=0.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6DA_77
symbols.comment: When X runs below zero, reload the 86-byte auxiliary index for the next low-bit distribution pass.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6DC_78
symbols.comment: Load the six-bit sector value before restoring its two missing low bits.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6DE_79
symbols.comment: Shift the next auxiliary low bit into carry.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6E2_80
symbols.comment: Shift the second auxiliary low bit into carry.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6E6_81
symbols.comment: Write the reconstructed eight-bit byte back through the destination pointer.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6EB_82
symbols.comment: Advance the destination pointer by one 256-byte page.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6ED_83
symbols.comment: Advance the requested sector for the next boot page.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6EF_84
symbols.comment: Load the updated sector number.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6F1_85
symbols.comment: Compare against the sector count stored in the boot block at $0800.

symbols.name: COMMENT_C6F8_86
symbols.comment: Execute BOOT1 at $0801 after the requested initial boot pages have been decoded.

notes: PC-scoped companion for DISKII_SLOT6.symbols.json. Load with override when replacing the original uploaded PROM table.
Every original symbol name is retained. Original L01..L23 names remain EQU aliases, while descriptive labels populate lbl and branch operands.
All original opcode guards are retained. Comments correct BIT, TSX, BPL, the Monitor step delay, BOOT0 scratch pointers, and the $0800/$0801 boot-block meanings.
The D2I_* aliases are meaningful only inside this ROM scope; X supplies slot*16 and, during seeks, the stepper phase offset.
No card-I/O addresses are moved into a global PC scope, and the two hardware datasets remain independent.
